profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at B-Stock Solutions
profile.summary: I have a fascination with software and technology. I like to learn a little bit of everything, I enjoy being active and I'm always looking for new challenges and more to learn.

positions.title: Moile Web UI Developer
positions.description:
Windstream, is a nationwide telecom provider, WincareCRM is an internal web application used by different departments of the company, it's used by sales, customer advocates, field technicians, customer support, among other groups. 

Our job is to make sure all different tools in the application, are mobile responsive and easy to use in any device, improve the UX by having a friendly UI that communicates with the user and improving the performance and response time of the application as well as the development new features required by business or requested by the users.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer (contract)
positions.description:
GMCertified is a web application for US market where users can look for pre-owned GM certified cars, contact dealers to sell their own cars, check the different dealer's inventories and specials.
 G2 Certified Used Cars is the equivalent application for the South African market.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
The projects are called  YourTexasBenefits and SDC Portal.

YourTexasBenefits is a self service portal where Texan citizens are able to apply online for multiple state benefits such as Food Stamps (Lone Star Card), Health Care, Medicare and long term services as nursing care or hospice services . 

The SDC Portal is a tool for state employees where they can register cases for Texas citizens in order to apply for state benefits.

company.name: Texas Health and Human Services Commission

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Naranya is a multinational company with presence on 17 countries in latin america, dedicated to generate and distribute mobile content.

Naranya Market is an online digital content store, it uses carrier billing as its main payment method. It                  focuses on LATAM market and offers content for Android devices. This was a special project for the                 company. The product business model was developed by the entire team, including developers (aka              hackers), designers and hostler, following LEAN Startup techniques. The team participated in listing             potential stakeholders and their problems, and then we went out to ask those potential stakeholders about their problems and how they look to solve it. This was to validate our assumptions. We made benchmarks with multiple online content stores to find out the main differences and similarities. After all this, we made some LEAN Canvas options for the business model. Once we chose one, we started designing the MVP solution, we validated this again with the stakeholders and then we started the development. It is the first company product working 100% on PaaS.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
The project name is SISCO (Stands for collection system).

This project was about developing the whole system for a micro finance company. The system’s features include potential customer analysis, checking if the customer or somebody living with him had a previous loan, and how much time they took to pay it back. 

This system also controls the checking account balance to avoid overdraft. It generates
the company's payroll, and financial reports. It has the capability of working with branch offices, each one with it’s own payroll, customers, accounts and everything else.

On this project I worked at the client’s central office, to analyze and understand the company's business model, and how they worked, what problems and needs they had and how to offer them the best solution. 

When we started, the company was resolving all its needs with Excel.
